title: Quick Savory Mediterranean Vegetable Tagine
description: A winey, light, and festive Mediterranean dish featuring cumin seeds and dum, perfect for a vegetarian-friendly meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin seeds and dried thyme and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cubed eggplant, sliced zucchini, and sliced red bell pepper, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the white wine and vegetable broth, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the liquid has reduced slightly, about 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
